_comment: No printed answer key in the source PDF — all 50 answers DERIVED (LWS NDA Atmosphere Test P1). Committed PRIVATE for spot-check. Reasons prefixed 'REVIEW' are lower-confidence (ambiguous wording or a debatable intended key) — verify against the LWS key before flipping PUBLIC.

1.reason: Tropopause height is max over equator (TRUE) + acts as a lid on vertical air movement (TRUE); its height is NOT constant year-round (FALSE) -> 1 and 2 only.

2.reason: REVIEW: troposphere is heated from the surface; with height pressure/density fall and air cools. 'Distance from Sun' (c) is the classic wrong distractor; 'decrease in pressure' is the conventional keyed answer. Confirm vs LWS key.

3.reason: Surface upward: Troposphere -> Stratosphere -> Mesosphere -> Thermosphere.

4.reason: Coriolis is zero at equator (TRUE) and increases to the poles (TRUE); it affects direction, NOT speed (3 FALSE) -> 1 and 2 only.

5.reason: Meteors burn up in the Mesosphere.

6.reason: Albedo = fraction of solar radiation reflected by Earth/a surface.

7.reason: Thermosphere is hot by day because it absorbs high-energy UV and X-rays.

8.reason: Nitrogen is not a greenhouse gas (methane, CO2, nitrous oxide are).

11.reason: REVIEW: exosphere is dominated by the lightest gases (H, He); hydrogen is usually keyed as the highest. Confirm vs LWS key (some sources say helium).

14.reason: Surface upward: Troposphere, Stratosphere, Mesosphere, Thermosphere.

15.reason: REVIEW: the normal lapse rate ceases (becomes ~0) at the tropopause, the top of the troposphere. Wording is ambiguous; confirm vs LWS key.

16.reason: All weather phenomena occur in the Troposphere.

17.reason: REVIEW: troposphere thickest at equator (1 TRUE); tropopause is colder over the equator than the poles, so its temperature is highest above the poles (2 TRUE); the lapse rate is ~1°C (not 1°F) per ~165 m (3 FALSE) -> 1 and 2 only. Confirm statement 2 intent vs LWS key.

18.reason: Troposphere temperature falls with height at the normal lapse rate of 6.5°C/km.

19.reason: Dark forest (low albedo) replaced by lighter cropland (higher albedo) -> albedo increases.

20.reason: Carbon monoxide is not a direct greenhouse gas; water vapour, methane, ozone are.

21.reason: Higher albedo -> more reflection, less absorption -> surface cools.

22.reason: The atmosphere is heated mainly by longwave terrestrial (Earth) radiation, not directly by the Sun.

23.reason: Oxygen is not a greenhouse gas.

24.reason: Rayleigh scattering: shorter-wavelength blue is scattered more than red (why the sky is blue).

25.reason: Dense forest has the lowest albedo (~0.1) of the options; snow/clouds/desert are higher.

26.reason: Albedo affects energy balance (TRUE) + ice increases planetary albedo (TRUE); 'deforestation ALWAYS decreases albedo' is FALSE -> 1 and 2 only.

27.reason: Fresh snow cover has the highest albedo (~0.8-0.9).

28.reason: Clouds form in the Troposphere (where water vapour and weather occur).

29.reason: Coriolis force increases with wind velocity (1 TRUE) and is max at poles / absent at equator (2 TRUE) -> both.

30.reason: S1 (solar = shortwave, TRUE) + S2 (terrestrial = longwave IR, TRUE); S3 FALSE — atmosphere is more transparent to incoming solar, and absorbs terrestrial longwave -> 1 and 2 only.

31.reason: S1 FALSE (atmosphere is heated more by terrestrial longwave than by incoming solar); S2 TRUE (CO2/GHGs absorb longwave) -> S1 incorrect, S2 correct.

32.reason: S1 TRUE (insolation is shortwave); S2 FALSE (insolation varies strongly with latitude) -> 1 only.

33.reason: Fresh snow has the highest albedo of the options.

34.reason: REVIEW: S1 stratosphere warms with height (TRUE), S2 mesosphere cools with height (TRUE), S3 lowest temperature near the mesopause/upper mesosphere (TRUE), S4 tropopause is an isothermal zone (TRUE) -> all four. Confirm S4 intent vs LWS key.

35.reason: Isotherms join points of equal temperature.

36.reason: REVIEW: most water vapour sits in the lowest atmosphere (1 treated TRUE); precipitable water DECREASES from equator to pole, so 2 FALSE -> Only 1. Confirm the '1000 m' figure vs LWS key.

37.reason: UV is absorbed mainly by ozone in the Stratosphere.

38.reason: Jet streams flow near the Tropopause.

39.reason: NOT correct: highest water-vapour concentration is in the troposphere, NOT the stratosphere (other options about the stratosphere are true).

40.reason: 1 FALSE (atmosphere heated more by terrestrial than solar); 2 TRUE (CO2/water vapour pass solar, absorb terrestrial) -> 2 only.

41.reason: S1 TRUE + S2 TRUE (max insolation over cloud-free subtropical deserts); S3 FALSE (the 'proximity to the sun' reasoning is wrong, and deserts—not the equator—receive max insolation) -> S1 and S2 only.

42.reason: S1 TRUE + S2 TRUE (Venus has the highest planetary albedo); S3 FALSE (FRESH snow has higher albedo than old snow) -> S1 and S2 only.

43.reason: S1 (conduction by contact, TRUE) + S2 (convection = vertical, TRUE); S3 FALSE (advection is HORIZONTAL heat transfer) -> S1 and S2 only.

44.reason: S1 (Earth radiates longwave, TRUE) + S2 (GHGs absorb it, TRUE); S3 FALSE (atmosphere heated more by terrestrial than solar) -> S1 and S2 only.

45.reason: Troposphere: 18 km equator / 8 km poles (TRUE), densest layer with dust+vapour (TRUE), 6.5°C/km lapse rate (TRUE) -> all three.

46.reason: Stratosphere ~18-50 km (TRUE) + ideal for aircraft (TRUE); S3 FALSE (the max-ozone layer is the ozonosphere, not the 'Mesopause') -> S1 and S2 only.

47.reason: Mesosphere up to ~80 km and coldest (TRUE), meteors burn here (TRUE), noctilucent clouds over poles in summer (TRUE) -> all three.

48.reason: S1 (thermosphere = ionosphere, radio reflection, TRUE) + S3 (ISS/satellites orbit in thermosphere, TRUE); S2 FALSE (Aurora Borealis is NORTHERN, Australis SOUTHERN — swapped) -> S1 and S3 only.

49.reason: S1 (apparent force from rotation, TRUE) + S2 (deflects right in NH, left in SH, TRUE); S3 FALSE (Coriolis is max at poles, zero at equator — swapped) -> S1 and S2 only.

50.reason: REVIEW: S1 (78% N2 / 21% O2, TRUE), S2 (~99% of mass within ~32 km, TRUE), S3 (radon anomalies studied for earthquake prediction, TRUE) -> all three. Confirm S3 intent vs LWS key.
